name: Anton Wilhelm Amo
shortBio: Ghanaian philosopher and university professor at Halle, Wittenberg, and Jena who formulated an incisive critique of Cartesian mind-body interactionism and defended natural rights.
centralQuestion: Can the immaterial mind truly suffer physical sensations, or does sensation belong exclusively to the living organic body?

keyWorks.title: On the Apatheia of the Human Mind
keyWorks.description: Rigorous critique of Cartesian dualism proving that sensation is purely physiological and the human mind is impassive (apathetic).

keyWorks.title: Treatise on the Art of Philosophising Soberly and Accurately
keyWorks.description: Comprehensive Enlightenment treatise on logic, epistemology, and the cognitive faculties of the intellect.
